test_title: PYST 25: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 2nd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends S, R, K, G and M are sitting around a circular wooden table, facing towards the centre of the table. S is sitting to the right of R. G is sitting to the left of K. R is sitting between K and S. M is sitting to the left of G. Who is sitting between M and R?
solution: **Given :** • **Five friends - S, R, K, G and M** • **They are sitting around a circular wooden table.** • **All of them are facing towards the center of the table.** ​**Explanation :** 1) S is sitting to the right of R.
